app.name: Kasuwa
app.tagline: CRM and contact centre, built in Africa
tokens.page.title: Design tokens
tokens.page.subtitle: Kasuwa Design {version} — the single source of truth for colour, type, spacing and motion.
tokens.provisional.notice: Provisional. These scales were derived from the three brand anchors in Prompt 0 and will be replaced by the Claude Design export. See decision D-L10.
tokens.contrast.label: {ratio} to 1 against {background}
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you asked for does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
tokens.approved.notice: Imported from the approved Claude Design export. Colour values are machine-extracted; editing them by hand is reverted by the next import.
auth.panel.headline: Every customer conversation. One place.
auth.panel.body: WhatsApp, calls, SMS and email for sales and support teams in Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Joburg and Dakar.
auth.panel.trust.encryption: Bank-grade encryption in transit and at rest
auth.panel.trust.compliance: Built for NDPA (Nigeria) and POPIA (South Africa)
auth.panel.trust.residency: Your data is stored in Africa
auth.signIn.title: Welcome back
auth.signIn.subtitle: Sign in to your Kasuwa workspace.
auth.signIn.workspace.label: Workspace
auth.signIn.workspace.help: The short name of your workspace, like sahel-bpo.
auth.signIn.email.label: Work email
auth.signIn.password.label: Password
auth.signIn.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
auth.locked.title: Your account is locked for 15 minutes
auth.locked.body: There were too many wrong passwords for {emailHint}. We lock the account to keep your customers' data safe.
auth.locked.resetSms: Get a reset code by SMS
auth.locked.notYou: Wasn't you? Your admin can see where the attempts came from.
auth.sso.title: Sign in with SSO
auth.sso.subtitle: Type your company's email domain. We'll take you to your company's sign-in page.
auth.sso.domain.label: Work domain
auth.sso.providers: Works with Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta and any SAML 2.0 provider.
auth.slow.title: Still connecting…
auth.slow.body: Your network is slow. Low-bandwidth mode loads a lighter page with no images.
auth.lite.on: Low-bandwidth mode is on. Turn it off any time from the top bar.
auth.lite.deferred: Google, Microsoft, SSO and passkeys load when you tap them.
auth.mfa.body.app: Enter the 6-digit code from Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or a similar app.
auth.mfa.body.sms: Code sent to {hint} by SMS. It works for 10 minutes.
auth.mfa.code.label: 6-digit code
auth.mfa.sms.slow: SMS can take up to 2 minutes on busy networks. Still nothing?
auth.mfa.sms.voice: Get the code by voice call
auth.attemptsRemaining: {count, plural, one {# more try before we lock the account for 15 minutes.} other {# more tries before we lock the account for 15 minutes.}}
auth.error.validation_failed: Some of what you typed is not right yet. Check the fields marked below.
auth.error.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match. Check for typos and caps lock.
auth.error.mfa_code_invalid: That code did not match. Check your authenticator app and try again.
auth.error.mfa_challenge_expired: This code has expired. Codes work for 10 minutes. Get a new one below — the old code won't work any more.
auth.error.resend_too_soon: Wait a moment before asking for another code.
auth.error.sso_domain_not_found: We couldn't find SSO for {domain}. Check the spelling, or ask your IT team if SSO is set up for Kasuwa.
auth.error.otp_invalid: That code did not match. Check it and try again.
auth.error.otp_expired: That code has expired. Codes last ten minutes.
auth.error.otp_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Ask for a new code.
auth.error.not_implemented: This part of Kasuwa is not ready yet.
auth.error.network: We could not reach Kasuwa. Check your connection and try again.
admin.shell.menu.label: Admin settings
admin.shell.residency.note: All workspace data, recordings and backups are kept in this region.
admin.home.title: Admin home
admin.home.health.title: Setup health
admin.home.health.fixes: {count, plural, one {Good, with # thing to fix} other {Good, with # things to fix}}
admin.home.health.allClear: Everything on this list is set up.
admin.home.health.points: Fixing them adds {points} points. Most take under 5 minutes.
admin.home.alerts.title: Alerts
admin.home.alerts.empty.title: No open alerts
admin.home.alerts.empty.body: Rejected templates, security gaps and plan limits will show up here.
admin.home.usage.title: Usage this month
admin.home.recent.title: Recent admin changes
admin.home.recent.seeAll: See all in the audit log
admin.prog.title: Programmes
admin.prog.intro: A programme is one client engagement: its agents, SLAs, scripts, dispositions and retention rules.
admin.prog.filter.label: Filter by status
admin.prog.noResults.title: No programmes match
admin.prog.noResults.body: Check the spelling, or clear the filters.
admin.prog.empty.title: No programmes yet
admin.prog.empty.body: Create one programme per client engagement. Agents, SLAs, scripts and retention rules all live inside it, so one client’s data never mixes with another’s.
admin.agents.presence.unknown.why: The telephony feed is unavailable, so this agent’s state is not known.
admin.agents.cover.title: Skill cover, {shift}
admin.agents.cover.subtitle: Agents rostered against forecast, {date} ({zone})
admin.sla.title: Response targets
admin.sla.subtitle: Agreed with the client in the contract. The client sees these on their portal.
admin.sla.invalid: Use a time such as 20 sec, 2 min or 24 h.
admin.sla.clock.title: Clock
admin.sla.pauseCustomer: Pause while waiting on the customer
admin.sla.pauseCustomer.note: When the case status is “Awaiting customer”
admin.sla.credits: Breaches are counted in the monthly service credit report.
admin.unsaved.count: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
admin.leave.title: Leave without saving?
admin.leave.body: If you leave now, your changes will be lost.
admin.disp.intro: Agents pick one at the end of every interaction. The order here is the order they see.
admin.disp.col.label: Label
admin.disp.delete.title: Delete “{label}”?
admin.disp.delete.usage: {count, plural, one {Agents picked this # time in the last {days} days.} other {Agents picked this # times in the last {days} days.}}
admin.disp.delete.body: Past interactions keep the label, but agents can no longer choose it and reports will group it under “Deleted”.
admin.disp.delete.hint: Deactivating hides it from agents but keeps reporting clean. You can turn it back on later.
admin.slow.title: Still connecting
admin.slow.body: Your connection is slow. You can switch to the lighter version of this page.
admin.error.title: We could not load this
admin.error.validation_failed: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
admin.error.not_found: This is not here. It may have been removed, or it may never have been yours to see.
admin.error.not_permitted: You do not have permission to do that.
admin.error.stale_write: Somebody else changed this while you were editing. Reload to see their version.
admin.error.duplicate_name: A programme with that name already exists.
admin.error.duplicate_code: A disposition with that code already exists.
admin.error.role_hierarchy_cycle: That move would make a role report to itself.
admin.error.role_in_use: People are still in that role. Move them first.
admin.error.legal_hold_active: A legal hold applies here, so this cannot be changed.
admin.error.too_many_requests: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then try again.
admin.error.service_unavailable: Kasuwa is busy. Try again in a moment.
admin.error.not_implemented: This part of Kasuwa is not ready yet.
admin.error.network: We could not reach Kasuwa. Check your connection and try again.
admin.roles.title: Roles hierarchy
admin.roles.intro: Roles decide whose records people can see. Each role sees its own records plus everything owned by roles below it.
admin.roles.dragHint: Drag a role onto another to change who it reports to, or pick “Reports to” in the side panel.
admin.roles.rootDrop: Drop here to make it a top-level role
admin.roles.inRole: {count, plural, one {# person in this role} other {# people in this role}}
admin.roles.sees.summary: {roles, plural, one {# role below} other {# roles below}} · {users, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
admin.roles.sees.more: and {count, plural, one {# more role} other {# more roles}}
admin.roles.sees.none: Only their own records. Sharing rules can add more.
admin.roles.delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
admin.roles.delete.body: Roles below it move up to report to its parent. This is recorded in the audit log.
admin.roles.delete.people: {count, plural, one {# person moves to the role you choose.} other {# people move to the role you choose.}}
admin.roles.unsaved: {count, plural, one {Role hierarchy: # change} other {Role hierarchy: # changes}}
admin.fls.title: Field-level security
admin.fls.intro: Choose who can read or edit each field. Fields without read access are hidden everywhere: lists, reports, exports and the API.
admin.fls.scope.note: These settings apply to permission sets across the whole workspace. To give one programme different rules, give its people a different permission set.
admin.fls.bulk.selected: {count, plural, one {# field selected} other {# fields selected}}
admin.fls.bulk.allUnlocked: Every permission set that can be changed
admin.fls.footer: {shown} of {total, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} · Edit includes read. Changes apply the next time each person loads a page.
admin.fls.unsaved: {count, plural, one {Field-level security: # change} other {Field-level security: # changes}}
admin.fls.saved: {count, plural, one {# change saved} other {# changes saved}}
admin.audit.title: Audit log
admin.audit.intro: Every admin, security and data action in this workspace. Entries cannot be edited or deleted, and are kept for 7 years.
admin.audit.ip.notShown.why: IP addresses are personal data. “Not shown” means this column is not available to you; it does not tell you whether an address was recorded.
admin.audit.empty.title: No events match these filters
admin.audit.empty.body: Try a longer date range or remove a filter. Events older than 7 years are no longer kept.
admin.audit.export.title: Export the audit log
admin.audit.export.body: We email a link to your own address and to nobody else’s.
admin.audit.export.format.json.note: Keeps the before and after detail
admin.audit.export.scope.filtered.note: Only the events you can see right now
admin.audit.export.scope.last_90_days.no: Everything from the last 90 days that you can see
admin.audit.export.ip.note: Off by default. IP addresses are personal data, and turning this on is recorded.
admin.audit.export.audited: This export is itself recorded in the audit log.
admin.audit.export.queued: We will email a link to {hint}. It expires after {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
admin.audit.export.queued.noHint: We will email a link to the address on your account.
admin.scripts.intro: Agents see the script for the channel and language of each interaction. A WhatsApp script must match a template the provider has approved.
admin.scripts.col.name: Script
admin.scripts.empty.title: No scripts yet
admin.scripts.empty.body: Scripts are written in the script builder. None have been added to this programme.
admin.ret.notice: These rules override the workspace default of {days}. Check the client contract and any sector rules before shortening a period. General guidance, not legal advice.
admin.ret.notice.noDefault: Check the client contract and any sector rules before shortening a period. General guidance, not legal advice.
admin.ret.scope.note: These are the rules recorded for this programme. Call recordings held by the telephony platform follow that platform’s own retention rule until the two are joined up, so shortening the period here does not delete the audio on its own.
admin.ret.row.recordings.note: Audio of every inbound and outbound call.
admin.ret.row.transcripts.note: WhatsApp, SMS and email threads, with attachments.
admin.ret.row.screen.note: Agent desktop captures used for QA.
admin.ret.onExpiry.delete.note: Files and text are erased from storage and backups within 30 days.
admin.ret.onExpiry.anonymise.note: Names, numbers and identifiers are removed. Counts and scores stay for reporting.
admin.ret.redact: Redact card numbers, BVN and NIN in transcripts
admin.ret.redact.note: Replaced before storage. Recordings pause while agents take card details.
admin.ret.hold.note: Stops all deletion for this programme until you turn it off. Use only when the client or a regulator asks.
admin.portal.empty.title: No client portal users yet
admin.portal.empty.body: Invite people from {client} to see live dashboards, QA scores and reports for this programme. They never see other clients’ data.
admin.portal.empty.body.noClient: Invite people from the client to see live dashboards, QA scores and reports for this programme. They never see other clients’ data.
admin.portal.notReady: Portal invitations are not available yet.
admin.archive.title: Archive {name}?
admin.archive.body: The programme stops taking new work straight away. You can restore it within {days} days; after that it stays read-only.
admin.archive.impact.agents: {count, plural, one {# agent loses access to this programme} other {# agents lose access to this programme}}
admin.archive.impact.interactions: {count, plural, one {# open interaction becomes read-only} other {# open interactions become read-only}}
admin.archive.impact.portal: {count, plural, one {# client portal user is signed out} other {# client portal users are signed out}}
admin.archive.impact.retention: Recordings and transcripts stay under the {rule} retention rule
